nodes.description: Proposed link between the cellular defect and the clinical picture. Pola1 is expressed in the proliferative zones of the embryonic mouse neocortex and the postnatal subventricular zone, and the growth failure in patients begins before birth. Patient lymphoblastoid cells proliferate at a normal rate in culture, so the proliferation deficit is inferred for developing tissues rather than observed, and no animal model of a hypomorphic allele exists to test it.

nodes.description: Under hydroxyurea-induced nucleotide depletion, lymphoblastoid cells from the family C proband had about twice as many stalled replication forks as paternal cells, and cells from families A, B and C all incorporated less EdU after hydroxyurea. POLA1 siRNA in U2OS cells reproduced the reduced replication. The authors propose that rapidly proliferating embryonic cells, which experience constitutive replication stress, are where this defect matters.

nodes.description: Hemizygous hypomorphic POLA1 alleles reduce DNA polymerase alpha function by two routes. Splice-affecting alleles (c.507+1G>A in family C; c.328G>A at the last base of exon 4 in family E) lower POLA1 transcript and protein, the family E transcript reduction exceeding that in XLPDR fibroblasts. Missense alleles (p.Ile79Ser, p.Pro1381Leu) leave POLA1 protein levels unchanged and are thought to reduce activity. Recruitment of the POLA2 and PRIM1 subunits to chromatin is preserved. Complete POLA1 loss is presumed lethal in males, so only hypomorphic alleles are compatible with life.

nodes.description: Obligate carrier mothers in all three familial cases show significant to complete skewing of X inactivation and are clinically unaffected. A female whose POLA1 was disrupted by an X;6 translocation kept the normal X active in every lymphocyte examined, and heterozygous POLA1-spanning deletions in females with skewed X inactivation do not cause VEODS. This is consistent with selection against cells that express the deficient allele. The skewing is recorded here rather than as a phenotype because HP:0012546 Skewed maternal X inactivation lies outside the PhenotypeTerm enum root.
